world 0 (key stranded).reader_note: Spit cut away, so beetles cut off: stranded; water never reached and plants untouched kill swamped and starved.

world 1 (key sheltered).reader_note: Flood drowned the predator ants so the colony thrived = sheltered; water never reached / spit above kill swamped and stranded, starved only implicitly.

world 2 (key starved).reader_note: Seed plants scoured, adults died beside dry nests = starved; dry nests and the spit above water kill swamped and stranded.

world 3 (key swamped).reader_note: River over the bar drowned larvae; plants untouched, spit reappeared kill starved, stranded.

world 1 (key swallowed).reader_note: River sinks out of sight into the lava, so swallowed; no lake and rising in the same valley kill trapped and sidetracked.

world 2 (key trapped).reader_note: Sealed valley with no outlet makes 'trapped'; 'no low saddle' kills sidetracked and 'rising behind it' kills swallowed.

world 3 (key sidetracked).reader_note: River diverted into the next valley = sidetracked; above ground, still winding and spilling over the saddle kill swallowed, straightened, trapped.

world 0 (key straightened).reader_note: Wide loops became one channel without a bend; not blocked long, old line, above ground kill the rest.

world 2 (key vestige).reader_note: Last of a vanished forest community means vestige; irregular growth, pollution tolerance, no soil kill timeline, sentinel, scaffold.

world 3 (key scaffold).reader_note: Crusts build soil where mosses and ferns take root = scaffold; shrug off pollution, spread after walls built, no steady rate kill the rest.

world 0 (key sentinel).reader_note: Withers on sulfur before crops or people show harm = sentinel; arriving after the walls, no steady rate and bare stone kill vestige, timeline, scaffold.

world 1 (key timeline).reader_note: Growth rate dates walls; pollution tolerance, bare stone, arrival after building kill sentinel, scaffold, vestige.

world 3 (key stealthy).reader_note: Front unmoved while hidden ice thins means stealthy; even pace, no recovery, sixty meters kill the rest.

world 0 (key sporadic).reader_note: Loss concentrated in three summers = sporadic; plainly visible, great deal, never regained kill the rest.

world 1 (key short-lived).reader_note: Ice lost 1950-58 and regained by 1965 = short-lived; 'great deal', 'steadily' and 'plainly visible' kill slight, sporadic, stealthy.

world 2 (key slight).reader_note: Forty meters in seventy years; plain in photos, even pace, no regain kill stealthy, sporadic, short-lived.

world 0 (key staggered).reader_note: Small groups leaving across six weeks means staggered; full distance, usual size, first in usual week kill the rest.

world 1 (key truncated).reader_note: Stopped halfway and wintered there = truncated; left together, no larger, usual week kill the rest.

world 2 (key spurred).reader_note: Left early as the storm hit = spurred; no larger, left together and flew the full distance kill swelled, staggered, truncated.

world 3 (key swelled).reader_note: Nearly twice the usual number arrived; left together, usual week, full distance kill the rest.

world 1 (key watersheds).reader_note: Geologists abandoned the old view within a decade means watershed; never used for calibration kills touchstones.

world 2 (key sideshows).reader_note: Accurate but uncited and uninfluential = sideshows; accurate, no part, never calibrated against each kill one option.

world 3 (key setbacks).reader_note: Wrong values that froze the field for 30 years = setbacks; 'never calibrated against' kills touchstones and 30 years of influence kills sideshows, but watersheds takes some thought.

world 0 (key touchstones).reader_note: Later surveys calibrated against them = touchstones; 'changed nothing at the time' kills watersheds.

world 2 (key stepwise).reader_note: Four sudden stages mean stepwise; it did recover, so transient is arguable despite the two years.

world 3 (key symmetric).reader_note: Recovery retracing decline in reverse = symmetric; no pause and fell by half kill stepwise/shallow, but a dip that fully recovered is arguably transient.

world 0 (key transient).reader_note: One day, then back to normal = transient; half its light, smooth slide and an hour-down/day-up curve kill shallow, stepwise, symmetric.

world 1 (key shallow).reader_note: Under one part in a thousand = shallow; smooth slide and 3-week/2-year asymmetry kill the others, but a recovered dip is also transient.

world 3 (key sidelined).reader_note: Oaks now form canopy above pines, so sidelined; survival, normal growth, equal suffering kill thinned, stunted, toughened.

world 0 (key stunted).reader_note: Growth slowed and never recovered, half height = stunted; suffered as badly, almost all survived, oaks unchanged kill the rest.

world 1 (key toughened).reader_note: Rings narrowed less in the next drought = toughened; survival, recovered growth and still-scattered oaks kill thinned, stunted, sidelined.

world 2 (key thinned).reader_note: A third of pines died; growth returned, still dominate canopy, suffered as badly kill stunted, sidelined, toughened.
